relations: Girl bouncing on the purple ball causes her torso to rise and fall rhythmically.
Purple ball shifts slightly on the rug as the girl bounces, retaining its spherical shape.
Girl's feet swing forward and back, staying lifted off the floor during the bouncing.
TV screen reflects the girl's silhouette, the dark shape shifting in sync with her bounces.
caption: The video captures a girl with a dark ponytail, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt, maroon leggings and pink socks, seated atop a large purple exercise ball near the center of a striped rug in a living room. She is already in motion, bouncing rhythmically up and down. Her torso and head rise and fall against the tall white display cabinet behind her. The purple ball keeps a broadly spherical shape while shifting only slightly across the rug as she rides the bounce. Her pink-stockinged feet stay lifted off the floor, swinging forward and back. The flat-screen TV on its low white stand reflects her moving silhouette, and the dark shape shifts in sync with each bounce. A blue exercise ball rests stationary at the left edge, and an open shelving unit lines the right wall. Framed pictures and a string of lights decorate the pale walls, while the rug edges and background fixtures remain consistently placed, suggesting a stationary camera. The bouncing continues steadily through the sequence.
